style.obj: Style: soft children's-book watercolour with fine brown ink outlines, gentle paper texture and warm soft light — the painting style of the clothes in the reference pictures. ONE object, front three-quarter view, centred, the whole object visible with a clear white margin on every side, filling about 85% of the picture height, on a pure flat white background (#FFFFFF). No ground shadow, no floor, no scenery. No people, no faces, no hands, no animals. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark anywhere.
style.costume: A child-size {what} costume displayed on a plain light-wood dress form: a headless torso form on one straight wooden pole with a round wooden base on the floor; a small round wooden knob on top of the neck holds the headwear. Every costume uses this same dress form. Framing exactly like the reference cart picture.
style.bg: Style: soft children's-book watercolour with fine brown ink outlines, warm morning light and gentle paper texture — the same painting style as the reference pictures. A wide 16:9 scene at eye level, calm and tidy with soft details; keep the middle of the picture fairly open and uncluttered (buttons will sit on top of it). Absolutely NO people, NO children, NO mannequins, NO animals, NO faces. NO text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere: every sign, banner, label and box is blank.

obj: There is no person, face, hand or animal (a headless wooden dress form is fine).
There is no text, letter, number or logo anywhere.
It is a soft watercolour illustration with ink outlines, like a children's book.
The background is plain flat white, and nothing touches the edges of the picture (the whole object is inside the frame with a margin).
bg: There is no person, child, mannequin, animal or face anywhere (look carefully at the edges, windows and the background).
There is no readable text, letter, number or logo anywhere (blank signs are fine).
It is a soft watercolour illustration with ink outlines, like a children's book.
The middle of the picture is fairly open, not crowded.

items.prompt: A quiet little shopping street in the morning. In the centre, Manny's clothes shop (like the shop front in the first reference): a cream shop front with a sage-green and cream striped awning, a big window showing hats, dresses and shoes, a wooden door, and a BLANK sign board. Pastel neighbouring shop fronts on both sides, potted plants and a bench, a wide cobblestone pavement in front. Composition like the second reference (a street view, open in the middle).
items.shows: a shopping street with a clothes shop in the centre, no people
